parameters: This elevator has five keyholes in a panel to operate it.  You currently don't have five elevator keys, so this elevator isn't going anywhere.
This elevator has five keyholes in a panel to operate it.  You put in five elevator keys and the elevator mechanically whirs to life.
You notice a display panel inside the elevator that has a message, saying that the bottom-most floors of the castle are flooded
with ocean water.  You decide you probably want to go up instead of down, anyways, and reach the higher parts of the castle you
saw from the outside before you ended up inside this place.
"Just a moment...  Have you figured out where the treasure room is?  The townspeople spoke of the hero or heros of the town
leading to the treasure room or something...  I hope to see that treasure room soon!"
"I want to go to the treasure room NOW!"
"Niko, hey, chill out already...  Yikes...  We're already on our way through this place, trying to figure out-"
You can see dollar eyes in Niko's eyes, black with evil.  You remember the look, back when you rescued Kaito.
"Fine!!!  I will be the hero of the town and have the destiny to find that treasure!!!  GO DROWN!!!"
Frustrated, angry, and totally psycho off-the-deep-end-and-into-outer-space, Niko shoves you hard into the elevator,
slaps the button for the lowest floor, and runs out of the elevator as the door closes.
You see Niko, slain, probably killed by the wandering monsters and bad guys.
Not surprisingly, you notice nearby cockroaches and other vermin keeping their distance, refusing to touch him, as if he would make a bad meal
and sicken them.  You don't feel the slightest bit sorry for this piece of slime that betrayed you.
"Geez \P[1], you shouldn't have forgiven a man like that, not after he betrayed us with Kaito...
History repeats itself if its allowed to, as the saying goes...
At least you can't make that mistake with him again."
"Yeah.  I'm sorry everyone, for being so stupid.  I just learned something the hard way.  At least its over now."
"Hey, its over, so its okay.  Anyone notice how the roaches are very carefully tip-toeing around his body as they crawl down the hallway?"
"Wouldn't surprise me if bacteria refuse to make his body rot, keeping their distance!"
"He is an evil piece of it.  Come on, let's go!"
This elevator requires a red elevator key.
This elevator requires a black elevator key.
